# Pokemon Web

> A browser-based Pokémon-style RPG built with Phaser 3 + TypeScript + Vite.

## Overview

Client-side static web app featuring 155 Pokémon, 244 moves, 82 registered map
entries from 66 map source files, turn-based battles, 50 achievements, and a
complete storyline. No backend. Built on Phaser 3 for 2D rendering, TypeScript for
type safety, and Vite for fast bundling. Requires Node 22.x as pinned in
`package.json` and `.nvmrc`.

## Source Structure

- `frontend/src/main.ts` — Entry point
- `frontend/src/config/game-config.ts` — Phaser game configuration
- `frontend/src/scenes/` — Phaser scenes organized by domain (boot, title, overworld, battle, menu, pokemon, minigame)
- `frontend/src/battle/` — Battle subsystem (isolated logic: FSM, damage, AI, effects)
- `frontend/src/data/` — Pure data files (Pokémon, moves, items, maps, trainers)
- `frontend/src/entities/` — Game entities (Player, NPC, Trainer)
- `frontend/src/managers/` — Singleton services (GameManager, SaveManager, EventManager, AudioManager)
- `frontend/src/systems/` — Gameplay systems (GridMovement, weather, lighting, audio, encounters)
- `frontend/src/ui/` — Reusable UI components (widgets, controls, theme)
- `frontend/src/utils/` — Pure helper functions (constants, math, type system)
- `scripts/map-gen/` — Tracked map generation, composition, preview, region render, and validation toolchain

## Commands

- `npm run dev` — Development server
- `npm run build` — Deterministic asset generation, type-check, and production build
- `npm run lint` — Report-only ESLint; warnings are expected
- `npm run lint:fix` — ESLint auto-fix
- `npm run format` — Prettier write
- `npm run format:check` — Prettier check
- `npm run test` — Unit + integration + replay Vitest suite
- `npm run test:unit` — Unit tests only
- `npm run test:integration` — Integration tests only
- `npm run test:coverage` — Vitest coverage with thresholds
- `npm run test:e2e` — Playwright end-to-end tests
- `npm run playtest:discover` — Generate reproducible desktop/mobile browser and layout bug reports
- `npm run agent:validate` — Validate agent customizations and shadow architecture
- `npm run agent:global:install` — Install the reusable workspace-researcher agent under `~/.copilot`
- `npm run agent:global:check` — Verify installed global resources and hashes
- `npm run shadow:validate` — Validate decision records, links, and feature mappings
- `npm run loop:dry-run` — Print the exact agent invocation without spending credits
- `npm run loop:run` — Run the bounded improvement loop and fold passes into `develop`
- `npm run loop:playtest` — Discover and repair reproducible playtest bugs in bounded cycles
- `npm run loop:gate` — Grade a worktree against the deterministic gate
- `npm run map:validate` — Validate all map definitions
- `npm run map:preview` — Render ignored PPM map previews under `temp/map-previews/`
- `npm run map:region` — Render the ignored region overview to `temp/region-map.ppm`

## Current Shared Frontend Primitives

- `frontend/src/scenes/scene-keys.ts`, `frontend/src/scenes/scene-data.ts`, `frontend/src/scenes/SceneRouter.ts`, and `frontend/src/scenes/SceneInputRegistry.ts` — typed scene keys/data/routing and listener teardown
- `frontend/src/ui/controls/SelectableController.ts`, `frontend/src/ui/widgets/ProgressBar.ts`, and `frontend/src/ui/widgets/TextBox.ts` — reusable menu/dialogue foundations
- `frontend/src/utils/grid-math.ts`, `frontend/src/utils/format.ts`, `frontend/src/utils/phaser-sequence.ts`, and `frontend/src/data/selectors.ts` — shared helpers and safe data lookups
- `frontend/src/battle/effects/registry/` and `frontend/src/battle/core/BattleStateMachine.ts` — battle effect registries and enforced FSM transitions
